instruction: Please help me enable bracket pair colorization in VS Code.

parameters.command: SETTINGS_PATH="$HOME/.config/Code/User/settings.json"; [ ! -f "$SETTINGS_PATH" ] && echo '{"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": false}' > "$SETTINGS_PATH" || (grep -q "editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled" "$SETTINGS_PATH" && sed -i 's/"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": false/"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": false/' "$SETTINGS_PATH" || jq '. + {"editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled": false}' "$SETTINGS_PATH" > temp.json && mv temp.json "$SETTINGS_PATH")

metadata.explanation: Task requires enabling bracket pair colorization in VS Code by changing from false to true. Evaluator uses existing check_json_settings function to verify the editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled setting in settings.json.

llm_judge_reasons: Complete instruction coverage: Evaluator checks the exact setting required to enable bracket pair colorization
Correct state extraction: get_vm_file extracts the VS Code settings.json from the correct path (/home/user/.config/Code/User/settings.json)
Correct metric logic: check_json_settings properly validates that editor.bracketPairColorization.enabled is set to true
Correct expected value: Expected value is true (boolean), which semantically matches the instruction to 'enable' the feature
Proper error handling: Metric handles JSON parsing errors and missing keys correctly
No postconfig needed: VS Code settings are persisted in the file system and don't require UI reopening
